title: Allahabad HC: A Working Mother Cannot Shift the Entire Child Maintenance Burden to the Father
case_name: Roji Bano and Another v. State of U.P. and Another
citation: Criminal Revision No. 6458 of 2025; 2026 LiveLaw (AB) 418, decided 16 July 2026
card_summary: Justice Lakshmi Kant Shukla dismissed a mother's revision against a Family Court order that gave her daughter Rs 3,000 monthly maintenance while refusing the mother's own claim. She had earlier won custody by asserting her financial capacity, and a salary slip showed she earned Rs 14,125 a month. The court held she could not then put the child's entire maintenance on the father alone.
card_tip: A parent's own pleadings on financial capacity, used to win custody, can later be turned against them to apportion the child's maintenance between both parents.
